How this bulletin is made. TransferBeat's three daily pieces (Lunch Break, Focus and Daily Recap) are written by the newsroom. No sentence is written by a language model and no number is estimated: if a figure is not in the data, it is not here. The bulletin does not replace the article of the day, it is its safety net.
